name: signoff-as-check
title: an owner told a sign-off is required adds a check on the step, not a new step
label: v3 AC-11 (sign-off)
description: Mission v3 §3.6 / §3.11 / AC-11. A scripted setup gives the owner A an active mission declared in ONE call with its plan (`mission_create { steps }`): one unit, the landing page's hero section, linked to the child session C that is building it. Then A runs ONE tick as an owner — it reads the shipped `mission` skill and decides its own calls — after the operator says the designer must sign off the hero section before it counts. The skill's rule: sign-offs become checks, not steps — `mission_add_check` on the step whose deliverable it confirms; only the operator ticks it. Graded from the mission file: the unit's step carries an agent-created, unticked check; the plan did not grow (no new step, no `human` step); the end carries no check; the mission is still active.

phases.prompt:
1. mcp__harnu__mission_create with folder="{{folder}}", title="Landing hero", sessionId="{{self}}", declaredEnd={"kind":"ui","target":"PR #5 (landing hero section) open, green and verified","evidence":"green CI, a capture of the rendered hero, and every AC verified"}, steps=[{"title":"Unit 1 — landing hero section","verification":"verifier"}].
2. mcp__harnu__mission_link_child with folder="{{folder}}", missionId=<missionId from step 1>, stepId=<the id of the step titled "Unit 1 — landing hero section" from step 1>, link={"kind":"session","ref":"{{session.C}}"}.

Skill file: .eval/mission-SKILL.md — run ONE tick, as its section "`mission` — one tick" says, on your mission {{m.landing-hero.id}}.

What changed since your last tick: the executor of "Unit 1 — landing hero section" (session {{session.C}}) is still building it. The operator just told you: "The designer must sign off the hero section before it counts as done. They'll look at it once the PR is up." Nothing else changed.

assert.label: the unit's step carries an agent check that names the sign-off
no check is ticked in any form — only the operator ticks
the plan did not grow: the unit and the end, nothing else
no human step was added for the sign-off
the check sits on the section's step, not on the end
